ns2:course.label: Growth and Dev of Hort Crops
ns2:course.description: Factors affecting growth, development, and quality of horticultural crops, such as photoperiodism, growth regulators, and carbon dioxide levels. Prerequisite: CHEM 104; HORT 421 or IB 420.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS:FSci &Hmn Nutrition -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educatn -UIUC, MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC, MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:course.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $387.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $353.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
